snippet_primary: "The math: on $10,000 monthly subscription revenue, YouTube Memberships pays out $7,000 to the creator while Patreon Pro pays out $8,700 to $9,200. Over a year, the fee difference equals $20,400 in favor of Patreon on $10,000 monthly revenue."
